description:
Render one PDF page as a PNG image: use it for wiring diagrams, connector pin views,
exploded views and tables that read poorly as text. Returns a short text part first (the page
link, its heading and text) and then the image. If no image reaches you, your client does not
pass images on: use the text, and give the user the link to see the page; asking again will not help.
If the image arrives as a file attachment instead (ChatGPT), show the user the page by embedding
that attached file in your answer, then give the link.
format="pdf" returns the page as a one-page PDF instead of the image (for clients that read PDFs
but not images).
An HTML file (one page) returns the pictures it shows, the diagrams and illustrations, up to 4 per
call: page=1 gives the first 4, page=2 the next 4.
name: page_image
title: Page image
